bulletHeading: He has been working on the following projects:
person1_text: He consults with boards of directors and management on the design of modern human resource processes that align with their business strategy. He consults with businesses and individuals as a strategic advisor and coach. His work focuses on talent development processes and succession systems in particular. He has been operating a coaching program based on the DNLA Expert System since 2009. He is also a co-author of I4F, an organizational culture analysis model and a competency model for successful performance in a digital business context.
person1_about: In 2002, he began his career as a business consultant. Prior to that, he worked in the computer industry in various management positions. He has worked as a director and senior consultant for Resultant d.o.o. (formerly HSC Skupina d.o.o.) since 2009. He is in charge of strategy, business development, sales, and marketing at Resultant. He counsels businesses on how to implement modern HR processes and adapt them to the demands of the digital economy. He is particularly interested in the study of organizational culture and how it affects business performance. He has a lot of experience in counseling, but his favorite role is as a personal coach who helps people develop their leadership and social skills.

person2_text: A professional with extensive knowledge of organizational climate, culture, and employee engagement. He consults organizations in the public and private sector on transforming organizational culture and upgrading HR processes. He consults, facilitates, and coaches individuals using DNLA programs. He is also one of the co-founders of I4F, a system for analysing organizational culture in the digital economy.
person2_about: He is a partner in Resultant d.o.o. (formerly HSC Group d.o.o.), where he is a procurator and Senior Internal Research Consultant with over 15 years of experience. He is responsible for the implementation and operational management of the SiOK project in Slovenia. He also provides guidance on the implementation of HR processes and IT solutions to support HR processes. He has been gaining expertise and experience for many years and is still driven by a constant desire to learn and develop. He comes from a sales and business background and has several decades of experience in people management. In Slovenia and the former Yugoslavia, he gained most of his experience managing sales teams. His thinking is guided by professionalism and business ethics.
